; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (myRocket Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((time (mk-time (value Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Event (mk-Event (duration Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((RocketMachine (mk-RocketMachine (e Ref)(impe Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-time (sel-time time))
  (lift-Event (sel-Event Event))
  (lift-RocketMachine (sel-RocketMachine RocketMachine))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-time ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-time (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-time ((this Ref)) time
  (sel-time (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Event ((this Ref)) Event
  (sel-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-RocketMachine ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-RocketMachine (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-RocketMachine ((this Ref)) RocketMachine
  (sel-RocketMachine (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-time ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-time this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Event this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-RocketMachine ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-RocketMachine this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.myRocket: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!myRocket ((this Ref)) Ref
  (myRocket (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class time:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for time.value: ---

(define-fun time.value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-time this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Event:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Event.duration: ---

(define-fun Event.duration ((this Ref)) Ref
  (duration (deref-Event this))
)

(define-fun Event!duration ((this Ref)) Ref
  (duration (deref-Event this))
)

; ------------------------------------
;   Getters for class RocketMachine:
; ------------------------------------

; --- getters for RocketMachine.e: ---

(define-fun RocketMachine.e ((this Ref)) Ref
  (e (deref-RocketMachine this))
)

(define-fun RocketMachine!e ((this Ref)) Ref
  (e (deref-RocketMachine this))
)

; --- getters for RocketMachine.impe: ---

(define-fun RocketMachine!impe ((this Ref)) Int
  (impe (deref-RocketMachine this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------------------
;   Methods for class RocketMachine:
; ------------------------------------

(define-fun RocketMachine.imp ((this Ref)(s Ref)) Int
  (ite (= s (RocketMachine.e this)) (* 50 (time.value (Event.duration s))) 0)
)

(define-fun RocketMachine!imp ((this Ref)(s Ref)) Int
  (ite (= s (RocketMachine!e this)) (* 50 (time.value (Event.duration s))) 0)
)

(assert (!(forall ((this Ref)(s Ref))
  (=>
    (and
      (deref-is-RocketMachine this)
      (deref-isa-Event s)
    )
    (let (($result (RocketMachine!imp this s)))
      (and
        (< $result 1800)
      )
    )
  )
) :named _xkassert352))

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-RocketMachine (TopLevelDeclarations!myRocket this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert353))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class time:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-time time)
(declare-const const-2-time time)
(declare-const const-3-time time)
(declare-const const-4-time time)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Event:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-Event Event)
(declare-const const-6-Event Event)
(declare-const const-7-Event Event)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Event.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-time (Event!duration this))
)

(assert (! (Event.inv1 5) :named _xkassert354))
(assert (! (Event.inv1 6) :named _xkassert355))
(assert (! (Event.inv1 7) :named _xkassert356))



; --------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class RocketMachine:
; --------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-8-RocketMachine RocketMachine)
(declare-const const-9-RocketMachine RocketMachine)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun RocketMachine.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RocketMachine!impe this) (RocketMachine!imp this (RocketMachine!e this)))
)

(assert (! (RocketMachine.inv1 8) :named _xkassert357))
(assert (! (RocketMachine.inv1 9) :named _xkassert358))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun RocketMachine.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Event (RocketMachine!e this))
)

(assert (! (RocketMachine.inv2 8) :named _xkassert359))
(assert (! (RocketMachine.inv2 9) :named _xkassert360))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun RocketMachine.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (RocketMachine!impe this) 1500)
)

(assert (! (RocketMachine.inv3 8) :named _xkassert361))
(assert (! (RocketMachine.inv3 9) :named _xkassert362))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-time const-1-time))
        2 (lift-time const-2-time))
        3 (lift-time const-3-time))
        4 (lift-time const-4-time))
        5 (lift-Event const-5-Event))
        6 (lift-Event const-6-Event))
        7 (lift-Event const-7-Event))
        8 (lift-RocketMachine const-8-RocketMachine))
        9 (lift-RocketMachine const-9-RocketMachine))
  )
)
